<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="th">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>mindfull — 2-Minute Mindful Reset</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Quicksand:wght@500;600;700&family=Prompt:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /*
    NOTE: Gotham Rounded is a licensed font, not available via free CDN.
    Quicksand stands in for EN numerals/labels here. Swap for the
    licensed Gotham Rounded font files in the real project.
  */
  :root{
    --turquoise-1:#00C4B3;
    --turquoise-2:#B3EDE8;
    --turquoise-3:#DBF0EE;
    --turquoise-text:#009688;
    --turquoise-gray-1:#355956;
    --turquoise-gray-2:#3F6866;
    --turquoise-gray-3:#528984;
    --turquoise-gray-4:#79ADA9;
    --marigo-1:#F9A000;
    --marigo-2:#F8E4B3;
    --guava-1:#8AD866;
    --blue-1:#1F77DF;
    --near-black:#17181A;
    --text-dark:#1B3634;
    --font-en:'Quicksand',sans-serif;
    --font-th:'Prompt',sans-serif;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0; height:100%; font-family:var(--font-th), var(--font-en); -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}

  body{
    min-height:100dvh;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #DFF7F3 0%, #EFFBF9 45%, #FFFFFF 100%);
  }

  .app{
    width:100%;
    max-width:420px;
    min-height:100dvh;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    padding:max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) 24px max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    position:relative;
  }

  .screen{ display:none; flex-direction:column; flex:1; }
  .screen.visible{ display:flex; }

  /* ---------- shared header ---------- */
  .logo{
    font-family:var(--font-en);
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:20px;
    color:var(--turquoise-text);
  }
  .logo .dot{ color:var(--blue-1); }

  /* ================= SCREEN 1 — CHECK-IN ================= */
  #screen-checkin .header-row{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    margin-bottom:8px;
  }

  .mooca-stage{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    align-items:flex-end;
    min-height:150px;
    margin:12px 0 20px;
  }

  .checkin-card{
    background:#ffffff;
    border-radius:20px;
    padding:24px 22px 20px;
    box-shadow:0 8px 24px 0 rgba(0,196,179,0.10);
  }

  .checkin-headline{
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:20px;
    color:var(--text-dark);
    text-align:center;
    margin:0 0 6px;
  }
  .checkin-subtext{
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--turquoise-gray-3);
    text-align:center;
    margin:0 0 22px;
  }

  .mood-row{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:8px;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }

  .mood-btn{
    width:52px; height:52px;
    border-radius:50%;
    border:none;
    background:var(--turquoise-3);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:background 0.25s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .mood-btn svg{ width:24px; height:24px; }
  .mood-btn:active{ transform:scale(0.92); }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="1"]{ background:var(--near-black); }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="2"]{ background:var(--turquoise-gray-1); }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="3"]{ background:var(--turquoise-1); }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="4"]{ background:var(--marigo-1); }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="5"]{ background:var(--guava-1); }

  .mood-feedback{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:6px;
    min-height:20px;
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--turquoise-gray-1);
    margin-bottom:4px;
  }

  .pacing-box{
    background:#F2F5F4;
    border-radius:16px;
    padding:16px 18px;
    margin:18px 0;
    display:flex;
    gap:12px;
  }
  .pacing-icon{
    width:32px; height:32px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--turquoise-2);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .pacing-title{
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:14px;
    color:var(--text-dark);
    margin:0 0 4px;
  }
  .pacing-text{
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--turquoise-gray-3);
    margin:0;
    line-height:1.5;
  }

  .cta-primary{
    width:100%;
    border:none;
    background:var(--turquoise-1);
    color:#ffffff;
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:500;
    padding:15px;
    border-radius:26px;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
  }
  .cta-primary:active{ transform:scale(0.97); background:var(--turquoise-text); }

  .meta-row{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:8px;
    margin-top:auto;
    padding-top:18px;
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:var(--turquoise-gray-3);
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .meta-row svg{ width:13px; height:13px; vertical-align:-2px; margin-right:3px; }
  .meta-dot{ opacity:0.6; }

  /* ================= SCREEN 2 — BREATHING ================= */
  #screen-breathing{ align-items:center; }

  .top-controls{
    width:100%;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    margin-bottom:8px;
  }
  .icon-btn{
    background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer;
    color:var(--turquoise-gray-3);
    font-size:18px;
    padding:6px;
  }
  .skip-link{
    background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer;
    font-family:var(--font-th); font-size:13px;
    color:var(--blue-1); text-decoration:underline;
    padding:6px;
  }

  .breathing-body{
    flex:1;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:26px;
    width:100%;
  }

  .phase-copy{ text-align:center; }
  .phase-headline{
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:23px;
    color:var(--text-dark);
    margin:0 0 6px;
  }
  .phase-subtext{
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:13.5px;
    color:var(--turquoise-gray-3);
    margin:0;
  }

  .ring-wrap{ position:relative; width:220px; height:220px; }
  .ring-svg{ width:220px; height:220px; transform:rotate(-90deg); }
  .ring-track{ fill:none; stroke:var(--turquoise-2); stroke-width:14; }
  .ring-progress{
    fill:none;
    stroke:var(--turquoise-1);
    stroke-width:14;
    stroke-linecap:round;
    filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(0,196,179,0.45));
  }
  .ring-center{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .countdown-num{
    font-family:var(--font-en);
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:44px;
    color:var(--text-dark);
    line-height:1;
  }
  .countdown-unit{
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:14px;
    color:var(--turquoise-text);
    margin-top:2px;
  }

  .progress-dots{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
  .dot{
    width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%;
    background:#D8DEDD;
    transition:all 0.3s ease;
  }
  .dot.done{ background:var(--turquoise-1); }
  .dot.active{
    width:14px; height:14px;
    background:var(--turquoise-1);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,196,179,0.18);
  }

  .step-caption{
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--turquoise-gray-3);
  }

  /* ================= SCREEN 3 — COMPLETE ================= */
  #screen-complete{ align-items:center; text-align:center; }

  .complete-header{
    width:100%;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    margin-bottom:24px;
  }
  .success-badge{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    background:#ffffff;
    border-radius:20px;
    padding:6px 14px;
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:12.5px;
    font-weight:500;
    color:var(--turquoise-text);
    box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,196,179,0.12);
  }
  .success-badge svg{ width:14px; height:14px; }

  .complete-body{
    flex:1;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:18px;
  }

  .complete-headline{
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:24px;
    color:var(--text-dark);
    margin:0;
    line-height:1.35;
  }

  .secondary-link{
    background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer;
    font-family:var(--font-th);
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--blue-1);
    max-width:26ch;
  }

  .complete-body .cta-primary{ margin-top:12px; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .ring-progress{ transition:none !important; }
  }
</style>
</head>

    <div class="mooca-stage">
      <img id="mooca-img" alt="Mooca mascot" style="width:150px;height:auto;" src="">

        <button class="mood-btn selected" data-mood="3" aria-label="ปกติ"><svg viewBox="0 0 21 15" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none">

      <span class="meta-dot">•</span>
      <span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M3 10v4h4l5 4V6l-5 4H3z"/><path d="M17 9l4 6M21 9l-4 6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>โหมดเสียงเงียบ</span>

<style>
  .mood-btn svg{ color:var(--turquoise-gray-3); }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="1"] svg{ color:#ffffff; }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="2"] svg{ color:#ffffff; }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="3"] svg{ color:#ffffff; }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="4"] svg{ color:#ffffff; }
  .mood-btn.selected[data-mood="5"] svg{ color:#1B3634; }
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  var MOOCA_ASSETS = {"default": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,", "mood1": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,", "mood2": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,", "mood3": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,", "mood4": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,", "mood5": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"};

  /* ---------------- Screen 1: check-in ---------------- */
  var moodMeta = {
    1:{ text:'หมดแรงและอารมณ์แปรปรวน', mouth:'sad',     tears:true,  sun:false, rainbow:false },
    2:{ text:'ค่อนข้างหดหู่',           mouth:'sad',     tears:false, sun:false, rainbow:false },
    3:{ text:'ปกติ',                    mouth:'neutral', tears:false, sun:false, rainbow:false },
    4:{ text:'รู้สึกแจ่มใส',            mouth:'happy',   tears:false, sun:true,  rainbow:false },
    5:{ text:'สดใส',                    mouth:'happy',   tears:false, sun:true,  rainbow:true  }
  };

  var moodButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.mood-btn');
  var feedbackEl = document.getElementById('mood-feedback');

  function setMooca(mood){
    document.getElementById('mooca-img').src = MOOCA_ASSETS[mood ? ('mood' + mood) : 'default'];
  }

  function selectMood(mood){
    moodButtons.forEach(function(btn){
      btn.classList.toggle('selected', btn.getAttribute('data-mood') === String(mood));
    });
    feedbackEl.textContent = moodMeta[mood].text;
    feedbackEl.style.visibility = 'visible';
    setMooca(mood);
  }

  moodButtons.forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      selectMood(btn.getAttribute('data-mood'));
    });
  });

  // initial idle state: no mood pre-selected, default Mooca shown
  feedbackEl.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  feedbackEl.textContent = 'ปกติ';
  setMooca(null);

  /* ---------------- Screen switching ---------------- */
  function showScreen(id){
    document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(function(s){ s.classList.remove('visible'); });
    document.getElementById(id).classList.add('visible');
  }

  window.goToBreathing = function(){
    showScreen('screen-breathing');
    startBreathing();
  };

  window.restart = function(){
    stopBreathing();
    showScreen('screen-checkin');
  };

  /* ---------------- Screen 2: breathing ---------------- */
  var phases = [
    { key:'in',      duration:4, headline:'สูดลมหายใจเข้า',    subtext:'หายใจเข้าอย่างช้า ๆ' },
    { key:'holdIn',  duration:4, headline:'กลั้นหายใจ',        subtext:'นั่งนิ่ง ๆ ขณะหายใจเต็มปอด' },
    { key:'out',     duration:8, headline:'พ่นลมหายใจออก',    subtext:'หายใจออกเพื่อคลายความตึงเครียดและผ่อนคลาย' },
    { key:'holdOut', duration:4, headline:'ค้างไว้',            subtext:'ว่างเปล่า และนิ่งสงบ' }
  ];

  var CIRC = 565.5; // 2 * PI * 90
  var stepIndex = 0;
  var secondsLeft = 0;
  var tickInterval = null;
  var running = false;

  var elHeadline = document.getElementById('phase-headline');
  var elSubtext = document.getElementById('phase-subtext');
  var elCountdown = document.getElementById('countdown-num');
  var elRing = document.getElementById('ring-progress');
  var elCaption = document.getElementById('step-caption');
  var dots = document.querySelectorAll('#progress-dots .dot');

  function vibrate(pattern){
    if('vibrate' in navigator){ try{ navigator.vibrate(pattern); }catch(e){} }
  }

  function updateDots(){
    dots.forEach(function(dot){
      var s = parseInt(dot.getAttribute('data-step'), 10);
      dot.classList.toggle('done', s < stepIndex + 1);
      dot.classList.toggle('active', s === stepIndex + 1);
    });
  }

  function applyStep(){
    var phase = phases[stepIndex];
    elHeadline.textContent = phase.headline;
    elSubtext.textContent = phase.subtext;
    elCaption.textContent = 'สเตป ' + (stepIndex + 1) + ' จาก 4';
    updateDots();

    secondsLeft = phase.duration;
    elCountdown.textContent = secondsLeft;

    elRing.style.transition = 'none';
    elRing.style.strokeDashoffset = '0';
    void elRing.getBoundingClientRect();
    elRing.style.transition = 'stroke-dashoffset ' + phase.duration + 's linear';
    elRing.style.strokeDashoffset = String(CIRC);

    if(phase.key === 'holdIn' || phase.key === 'holdOut'){
      vibrate(30);
    }
  }

  function tick(){
    secondsLeft -= 1;
    if(secondsLeft <= 0){
      stepIndex += 1;
      if(stepIndex >= phases.length){
        finishBreathing();
        return;
      }
      applyStep();
    }else{
      elCountdown.textContent = secondsLeft;
    }
  }

  function startBreathing(){
    stepIndex = 0;
    running = true;
    applyStep();
    clearInterval(tickInterval);
    tickInterval = setInterval(function(){
      if(running) tick();
    }, 1000);
  }

  function stopBreathing(){
    running = false;
    clearInterval(tickInterval);
  }

  window.finishBreathing = function(){
    stopBreathing();
    vibrate([20,40,20]);
    showScreen('screen-complete');
  };
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
